applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India ( Urban Co-operative Banks – Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Second Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Urban co-operative banks may now invest in equity shares of the Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) for membership.
answer.action_quote: Equity shares of Umbrella Organization (UO) of UCB sector and Indian Digital Payment Intelligence Corporation (IDPIC) for acquiring membership;

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Urban Co-operative Banks - Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Directions, 2025
